items.title: Press Freedom Tracker year to date — 2026-10-27
items.summary: 253 incidents Jan 1 to Oct 27, 2026 excluding chilling statements (278 in the same span of 2025); latest incident dated 2026-10-21. By category: Assault 168, Arrest/Criminal Charge 44, Equipment Damage 31, Subpoena/Legal Order 22, Chilling Statement 21, Other Incident 13, Denial of Access 9, Equipment Search or Seizure 7, Prior Restraint 3, Leak Case 2, Border Stop 1.
